question_text: Write an ANSI SQL query to compute sample count, conversion rate, and ARPU for each variant in `experiment_events_7`.
correct_answer:
SELECT variant,
       COUNT(*) AS total_users,
       ROUND(SUM(converted) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS conversion_rate,
       ROUND(AVG(revenue), 2) AS arpu
FROM experiment_events_7
GROUP BY variant
ORDER BY variant ASC;
answer_explanation: Computes conversion rate and average revenue per user (ARPU) across A/B experiment variants.
